content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Research integrates heterogeneous geospatial datasets from multiple utility operators with explicit representation of vertical position uncertainty and assigns probabilistic uncertainty models to infrastructure records lacking reliable depth information.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-10175","field":"abstract","quote":"harmonising data from multiple operators who record geometry, attributes, and depth information"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-10175","field":"abstract","quote":"a Gaussian uncertainty model was assigned based on utility type and installation period"}]},{"text":"Work develops structured validation workflows to detect geometric conflicts between utility geometries and resolve coordinate reference system inconsistencies in spatial databases.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-10175","field":"abstract","quote":"Geometric conflicts between utility geometries were detected at 1 240 locations, of which 61% were attributable to CRS inconsistencies"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-10170","field":"abstract","quote":"topological validation workflow applied to the water supply network dataset"}]},{"text":"Research implements multi-source data fusion using OGC standards and common 3D data models to harmonise utility operator records at different levels of accuracy.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-10175","field":"abstract","quote":"A common 3D data model was designed as a profile of the OGC CityGML Utility Network ADE"},{"id":"R0971","field":"keywords","quote":"multi-source data fusion"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher's work on probabilistic uncertainty models for subsurface utilities with missing depth information [SYN-PUB-10175], detection and resolution of geometric conflicts in utility geometries [SYN-PUB-10175], and topological validation of spatial databases [SYN-PUB-10170] directly addresses the challenge of locating legacy cables with poor documentation accuracy and providing confidence intervals on cable position."}
